goal: Decide if a two-seed UOR-R4 run beats its baselines, so a result inside the noise is never called a win.

app.name: r4-seed-gate
app.title: Two-seed bar
app.purpose: Decide whether a saved UOR-R4 model passes the two-seed bar on a test panel, from each seed's top-1 rows right, the unigram baseline and the required target T2 plus max(24, the seeds' spread).

fields.name: seed1
fields.means: rows the seed 1 artifact gets right

fields.name: seed2
fields.means: rows the seed 2 artifact gets right

fields.name: unigram
fields.means: rows the unigram table gets right

fields.name: t2
fields.means: rows the T2 previous-word table gets right

fields.name: target
fields.means: the required target: T2 plus max(24, the absolute difference of the two seeds)

meanings.pass: both seeds beat the unigram table and reach the target
meanings.trails-unigram: a seed does not beat the unigram table
meanings.split: one seed reaches the target and the other does not
meanings.inside-band: both seeds miss the target, at least one at or above T2: inside the noise band, not a win

stakeholders.name: Researcher
stakeholders.text: Runs training experiments and needs each two-seed result classified by the pre-registered bar, negative results included.

stakeholders.name: Reviewer
stakeholders.text: Reads the research notebook and needs no result inside the noise band or at one seed reported as a win.

components.name: d11-scorer
components.text: The artifact scorer that counts each seed's top-1 rows on a panel.

components.name: Research notebook
components.text: docs/research/notebook, where every result is one row.

threats.name: Single-seed win reported
threats.text: One seed's score above the target is reported as a pass while the other seed misses it.

control.name: Both seeds bar
control.text: Each seed must reach the target.

threats.name: Target below the noise floor
threats.text: A caller sends a target below T2 plus 24, so a noise-level gain passes.
threats.accepted: The target is computed by the pre-registered gate sheet before scoring; the app compares against the target it is given.

threats.name: Sealed panel scored early
threats.text: The fresh panel is scored before the DEV decision, so the pass is not a confirmation.
threats.accepted: refuse_sealed_fresh_source in the scorer guards the seal; this app only classifies counts.

quality.text: A pass needs both of the two seeds to reach the target.
quality.measureText: Seeds that must reach the target before pass.

quality.text: No result with a seed below the target is answered pass.
quality.measureText: Acceptance vectors with a seed below the target answered pass.
